$comment: Listing fields that apify push never sends, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json. The evidence for the name, the price and every listing field: manager/docs/MARKET_CHECK/maigret-username-search.md.
actorId$comment: Pinned by ID: CI pushes to this ID (actor-id of apify/push-actor-action) and store-metadata.mjs looks it up by ID, so a new name in actor.json renames the same actor instead of creating a second one (created by the first CI push, run 36570592902, 2026-09-29).
seoTitle: Username Search & Lookup - Maigret OSINT Tool
seoDescription: Search any username on 5,000+ websites and social networks. Get profile links, real names, bios, follower counts and linked handles. No login needed.
exampleRunInput$comment: Equal to the INPUT_SCHEMA prefill, so it is also the input of Apify's daily QA run (must succeed with rows within 5 minutes). On Apify, build 1.0.3, 2026-09-29: soxoj on 509 sites plus the linked usernames on its GitHub page, 40 to 41 profiles in 85 s (4 GB) and 96 s (2 GB), about $0.60 at the price below. MAX_LINKED 3 keeps the worst case at 4 scans of about 40 s.
isPublic$comment: Published 2026-09-29 (build 1.0.4) after the platform tests on build 1.0.3: the example input at 4 GB and 2 GB, a full 5,178-site scan at 4 GB and 2 GB, a pasted link with a country name, a $0.05 spending limit (3 rows, 3 charges), an unreadable username (FAILED at $0 with the plain message) and an empty form (refused by the platform before starting). Charged profile events equalled saved rows on all 7 runs. A paid public actor cannot be made private again until monetization is cancelled in Console.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 2048 MB, measured on Apify 2026-09-29 (build 1.0.3): the example input took 96 s and $0.0117 at 2 GB against 85 s and $0.0200 at 4 GB; a full 5,178-site scan took 241 s and $0.0305 at 2 GB against 164 s and $0.0401 at 4 GB. Accounts found were the same (41 against 40, 67 against 69) and so were the unreachable sites (616 against 620). Peak memory 250 to 271 MB, so 2 GB is for the CPU share (Apify gives 1 core per 4 GB), not the memory. actor.json caps memory at 4096 MB because the developer pays for compute under pay per event. 3600 s: a full scan is about 4 minutes per username, so about 14 usernames an hour; the run stops scanning 45 s before the limit and keeps every site already checked.

pricing.$comment: SET 2026-09-29 under the owner rule (a little below the main competitor on the same job, extreme margin). MAIN COMPETITOR: ntriqpro/maigret-actor, 167 users in 30 days on 2026-09-29 (next Maigret actors: bovi 38, apivault_labs 22). Its prices are tiered: per profile FREE $0.02, BRONZE $0.016, SILVER $0.013, GOLD and up $0.0104, plus a run-started fee of $0.005 / $0.004 / $0.00325 / $0.0026. Only paid-plan users bring revenue (SEO.md 16.5), and most sit on BRONZE, so the anchor is BRONZE: $0.015 per profile is 6% under its $0.016 with no run fee, and 25% under its free-plan $0.02. WHERE WE ARE NOT CHEAPER: its SILVER ($0.013) and GOLD ($0.0104) buyers, and the Sherlock and 400-site actors that read no profile details (datacach $0.00099 a result, crawlerbros $0.001, automation-lab $0.005 a username, khadinakbar $0.04 a username, our own social-analyzer $0.005 a profile). TIERS: SEO.md 16.7 says to tier when the main competitor falls on paid tiers, which it does; but apify SDK 3.4.1 (the newest stable 3.x) requires eventPriceUsd on every event, so a tiered record without it would stop every run at start (the telegram note). Test a tiered record on a private build before switching. COST AND MARGIN (measured on Apify, build 1.0.3, 2 GB, 2026-09-29): the example input cost $0.0117 of platform usage for 41 profiles ($0.0003 a profile) and a full 5,178-site scan $0.0305 for 67 profiles ($0.0005 a profile), almost all compute at $0.20 per CU (downloaded pages are not billed as external transfer). Developer share 0.8 x $0.015 = $0.012 a profile, so the example earns $0.49 against $0.0117 (42x) and the full scan $0.80 against $0.0305 (26x). Break-even is 1 profile on 500 sites and 3 on all sites; a username found nowhere loses $0.012 to $0.031. Free-plan users bring $0 and Apify covers their platform cost (docs monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The owner's own runs are billed platform usage only, not the profile events. REVENUE: $1,000 a month needs about 83,000 profiles from paid-plan users, about 1,500 usernames at 40 to 67 profiles each. No start fee: an empty or rejected run bills $0. Do not add apify-default-dataset-item (it would charge every row twice). The event name must equal PROFILE_EVENT in src/main.py.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing for 1.0: $0.015 per profile found, below the main Maigret actor's $0.016 Bronze price plus its run fee. No start fee: a username found nowhere costs $0.

profile.eventDescription: One found profile row: the site, the profile link and what Maigret read from the page (name, bio, location, followers, join date, photo, links and other usernames). Charged as each username's rows are saved. A username found nowhere costs nothing. No start fee.
